sources.title: Mistral 7B
sources.snippet: The best 7B model to date, Apache 2.0 Mistral 7B uses a sliding window attention (SWA) mechanism (Child et al., Beltagy et al.), in which each layer attends to the previous 4,096 hidden states. The main improvement, and reason for which this was initially investigated, is a linear compute cost of O (sliding_window.seq_len). sources.title: Mistral 7B and Its Open-Source Impact | Obot AI - Acorn
sources.snippet: Mistral 7B's accessibility and performance make it a valuable resource for researchers and developers in AI, particularly for those interested in training and running LLMs with constrained resources. A common use case of the model is to fine-tune it using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques like LORA.
